name: cublas_cublasDcopy_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasDcopy_v2.py. Double-precision strided vector copy y<-x via the real cuBLAS baseline. x/y are real float64 tensors with storage sizes 1+(n-1)*incx / 1+(n-1)*incy taken from the test. reference mutates y in place and returns it. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
